card.en: Why one target can show two arrival peaks, and what removes the second: my single-author paper, submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal).
card.zh: 一个目标，到达时间为何会出现两个峰？第二个峰又因什么而消失？我把答案写成了单作者论文，已投稿《物理评论 E》。

why.en: First-passage times are everywhere a search has to succeed: a molecule finding a receptor, a signal crossing a network, a pest finding a trap (Chapter 07).
why.zh: 凡是需要「找到」的地方都有首达时间：分子找到受体、信号穿过网络、害虫走进诱捕器（见第 7 章）。

thesis.en: Why one target can show two arrival peaks, and what removes the second: my single-author paper, submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal).

title.zh: 几何控制的折叠：双峰论文

status.en: Submitted to Physical Review E · Jul 2026

card.en: Single-author paper submitted to Physical Review E (Jul 2026): why first-passage times can show two peaks, and when the second disappears.
card.zh: 单作者论文，2026 年 7 月投稿《物理评论 E》：随机游走首次到达目标的时间分布为何出现双峰、第二个峰何时消失。

title.en: Why a second peak appears — and disappears
title.zh: 第二个峰为何出现，又为何消失

card.en: In the diffusive limit a sink stands in for the shortcut. Sink at the midpoint, strength ≈ 3.08: the late peak and a valley meet and vanish.
card.zh: 在扩散极限下，用一个汇代替捷径（秩一吸收缺陷）。汇在正中、强度约 3.08 时，晚峰与谷相撞，一同消失。

card.zh: 固定预算论文的全部代码、数值记录、机器核验的证明与超算作业记录，公开并由校验值锁定——v1.3.0，2026 年 9 月。

title.zh: 跳过输入法？

dek.en: First AI paper · UKAIRS 2026, the UK AI Research Symposium
dek.zh: 第一篇 AI 论文 · 英国 AI 研究研讨会（UKAIRS 2026）

card.en: Can agents follow pinyin (romanised Chinese) alone? 48 exploratory runs: everyday instructions worked; proper names and homophones needed characters.
card.zh: 只打拼音，AI 智能体能照着做吗？爱丁堡海报中 48 次调用的探索性实验：日常指令可以，专名和同音词仍要汉字。

why.en: Many languages are typed through an input method — software that turns typed letters into characters — or a romanisation: pinyin (romanised Chinese), Japanese romaji, Arabizi. Knowing where meaning survives the shortcut tells people when they can skip that step with an AI agent.
why.zh: 很多语言都要靠输入法或罗马化来打字——拼音、日语罗马字、阿拉伯语的拉丁转写。弄清楚意思在哪里会丢，才知道什么时候可以跟 AI 智能体省掉这一步。

thesis.en: Can agents follow pinyin (romanised Chinese) alone? 48 exploratory runs: everyday instructions worked; proper names and homophones needed characters.
thesis.zh: 只打拼音，AI 智能体能照着做吗？爱丁堡海报中 48 次调用的探索性实验：日常指令可以，专名和同音词仍要汉字。

title.en: The key finding: toneless pinyin erases homophones
title.zh: 核心发现：无声调拼音抹掉同音字

card.en: 事实 and 实施 are both ‘shi shi’. Pinyin-only prompts scored 0.333; keeping the key word in Chinese characters restored 1.00.
card.zh: 「事实」与「实施」都是 shi shi。纯拼音提示只得 0.333；把关键词留成汉字，就回到 1.00。

card.zh: UKAIRS 2026 录用本文，以海报展示。评审特别点出「shi shi」这个例子，建议以它开场。

title.zh: 一种 AI 原生的做数学方式

title.zh: 展台

card.en: For a cloud-communications company I designed a Madrid trade-show kit and an AI platform logo, joined two shows and gave a 93-minute AI primer.
card.zh: 我为一家云通信公司设计了马德里展会物料，也为它的 AI 平台设计了标志；随团参加两场国际展会，讲了一堂 93 分钟的大模型入门课。

why.en: A company’s AI work is judged partly by how it presents itself — in English, on trade floors and in print — and by whether its own people can work with AI agents.
why.zh: 一家公司的 AI 做得怎样，一半要看它怎么展示自己——用英文、在展会上、在印刷品里；也要看它自己的员工，能不能和 AI 智能体一起工作。

dek.zh: BioPath · 2026 年早期职业创业学者（同届 12 人）· New Enterprise：Growth 阶段

card.en: My prototype BioPath uses first-passage maths to place traps on farms and in grain stores to cut rodenticide use. Early Career Enterprise Fellow 2026.
card.zh: BioPath 是我做的原型：用首达数学算出农场和粮仓的诱捕器该放在哪儿，好少用灭鼠药。2026 年 Early Career Enterprise Fellow。

why.en: Where traps go is still largely a judgement call; placing them well could mean fewer chemical rodenticides.
why.zh: 诱捕器放在哪儿，至今多半凭经验判断；放得准，有望少用化学灭鼠剂。

thesis.en: My prototype BioPath uses first-passage maths to place traps on farms and in grain stores to cut rodenticide use. Early Career Enterprise Fellow 2026.
thesis.zh: BioPath 是我做的原型：用首达数学算出农场和粮仓的诱捕器该放在哪儿，好少用灭鼠药。2026 年 Early Career Enterprise Fellow。

title.zh: 2026 年早期职业创业学者

card.en: BioPath — mathematics that works out where to place traps on farms and in grain stores — won a place in the 2026 cohort of twelve fellows.
card.zh: BioPath——用数学算出农场和粮仓的诱捕器该放在哪里——入选 2026 届，同届共 12 人。

title.en: The BioPath platform: map in, traps out, proof attached
title.zh: BioPath 平台：地图进，布点出，附证明

card.en: A site map and a budget in; trap coordinates out, chosen for the best chance of a catch within a set time, with evidence anyone can re-run.
card.zh: 输入场地地图与预算，输出诱捕器坐标，让限定时间内捕获的概率尽量高，并附一份谁都能复跑的证据包。

title.en: A PechaKucha (20 slides, 20 seconds each) at the Festival of Enterprise
title.zh: 创业节上的 PechaKucha 路演

card.en: Twenty slides, twenty seconds each, at the Arts Complex on 10 June 2026: ‘Map in. Traps out. Proof attached.’
card.zh: 2026 年 6 月 10 日，二十页幻灯片、每页二十秒的路演：「地图进，布点出，附证明」。

title.zh: 「从草莓田到博士」

card.en: The Careers Service’s Student Founder Spotlight on BioPath, published 21 September 2026.
card.zh: 就业服务中心的 Student Founder Spotlight（学生创业者聚焦）专栏介绍 BioPath，2026 年 9 月 21 日发布。

title.zh: 信号

card.en: What I have published: WeChat videos and referenced articles, LinkedIn as a notebook, bilingual subtitles, this site.
card.zh: 我公开发布的内容：视频号短视频与带参考文献的长文，把领英当笔记本来写，给视频配双语字幕，还有这个网站。

why.en: Work that no one sees has not quite arrived: posts, talks and videos, in two languages, are how it reaches people.
why.zh: 没人看见的工作，还不算真正抵达：中英两种语言的帖子、演讲与视频，就是它抵达别人的方式。

thesis.en: What I have published: WeChat videos and referenced articles, LinkedIn as a notebook, bilingual subtitles, this site.
thesis.zh: 我公开发布的内容：视频号短视频与带参考文献的长文，把领英当笔记本来写，给视频配双语字幕，还有这个网站。

title.zh: 微信内容工作室

card.en: Launched August 2026 on WeChat Channels and a WeChat Official Account, run with AI tools — a human always presses publish.
card.zh: 2026 年 8 月在视频号和公众号启动，由 AI 工具协助运转——「发表」键永远由人来按。

title.zh: 把领英当作公开的笔记本

card.en: Two years of milestone posts — a PhD, a fellowship, a festival pitch — to 888 followers at an April 2026 snapshot.
card.zh: 两年来的里程碑帖子——读博、创业学者、创业节路演——2026 年 4 月的快照显示有 888 位关注者。

title.zh: 自己搭的中英双语字幕流水线

card.en: No subtitle renderer in ffmpeg: each cue became a transparent image, overlaid in parallel chunks — an 8 min 44 s 4K clip in about 2½ min.
card.zh: ffmpeg 缺了字幕渲染器，就把每条字幕画成透明图片，分块并行叠加——8 分 44 秒的 4K 素材，约两分半钟出片。

title.en: A camera roll as a diary: 3,947 videos
title.zh: 把相机胶卷当日记：3947 段视频

card.en: September 2023 to August 2026: 140, 1,310, 1,574 and 923 videos a year. Aggregates only — no clip is ever shown.
card.zh: 2023 年 9 月到 2026 年 8 月：每年 140、1310、1574、923 段。只呈现汇总，任何片段都不公开。

title.zh: 本站：至此

card.en: The record drawn as a first-passage process — at the address that redirected to LinkedIn from April to September 2026.
card.zh: 把经历画成一场首达过程——就在这个 2026 年 4 月至 9 月一直跳转到领英的网址上。

title.zh: 向西

dek.en: Silicon Valley, 2025 · an internship at LiveX AI, a Bay Area AI start-up
dek.zh: 2025 年夏 · 硅谷 AI 创业公司 LiveX AI 实习

card.en: Summer 2025 in Silicon Valley: an entrepreneurship programme and a research internship at LiveX AI (4–16 Aug) — where my turn toward AI began.
card.zh: 2025 年夏在硅谷：一段创业研学，外加 8 月 4 日至 16 日在 LiveX AI 的研究实习——我转向 AI，就从这里开始。

why.en: It is where the question behind the later AI work first appeared: judge a tool by whether its output answers real questions, not by how it looks.
why.zh: 后来 AI 工作背后的那个问题，最早出现在这里：评判一个工具，要看它的输出能不能回答真实问题，而不是看它长得好不好。

thesis.en: Summer 2025 in Silicon Valley: an entrepreneurship programme and a research internship at LiveX AI (4–16 Aug) — where my turn toward AI began.
thesis.zh: 2025 年夏在硅谷：一段创业研学，外加 8 月 4 日至 16 日在 LiveX AI 的研究实习——我转向 AI，就从这里开始。

title.zh: LiveX AI 研究实习

card.en: 4–16 August 2025, Silicon Valley: testing how best to turn product manuals into clean text (Markdown) for an AI knowledge base.
card.zh: 2025 年 8 月 4 日至 16 日，硅谷：为 AI 知识库测试怎样把产品手册最好地转成干净的文本（Markdown）。

title.zh: 硅谷创业项目

card.en: About three weeks on Tianjin University’s programme in the Bay Area, run with Founders Space: workshops, company visits, founders.
card.zh: 在天津大学与 Founders Space 合办的湾区项目里待了约三周：工作坊、企业参访、与创业者交流。

title.en: LiveX AI internship: a retrieval-QA benchmark for document parsers
title.zh: LiveX AI 实习：文档解析器的检索问答评测基准

card.en: Parsers judged by usefulness, not looks: 5 parsers × 9 documents × 100 questions per document; confident wrong answers tracked separately.
card.zh: 不看长得像不像，只看有没有用：5 个解析器 × 9 份文档 × 100 道题（每份文档 100 道）；自信却答错的单独统计。

title.zh: 作坊

card.en: What I built in the gaps, mostly so someone else could move faster: a maths guide, a travel-story app, a cursor tool, an agent bridge.
card.zh: 我见缝插针造出来的东西，多半是为了让别人走得更快：数学指北、旅行故事应用、光标工具、智能体之桥。

why.en: Small public tools are where new methods get tried first, at a scale where failing is cheap.
why.zh: 小而公开的工具，是新方法最先试手的地方——在这里失败，代价很小。

thesis.en: What I built in the gaps, mostly so someone else could move faster: a maths guide, a travel-story app, a cursor tool, an agent bridge.
thesis.zh: 我见缝插针造出来的东西，多半是为了让别人走得更快：数学指北、旅行故事应用、光标工具、智能体之桥。

title.zh: London Cuts 旅行故事工作室

card.en: A travel-story studio: AI-made postcards in six art styles, stories in three visual modes (Fashion, Punk, Cinema) and a live demo.
card.zh: 旅行故事工作室：六种画风的 AI 明信片，故事有时装、朋克、电影三种视觉模式，附在线公开演示。

title.en: SocialOS: a local-only social-memory assistant, built in five days
title.zh: SocialOS：五天做出的本机社交记忆助手

card.en: A local-only relationship and identity OS, built mostly by automated coding agents: 89% of the commits were theirs.
card.zh: 一个只在本机运行的人际关系与身份操作系统，主要由自动编程智能体建成：89% 的提交出自它们。

title.zh: 天津大学数学学院本科生指北

card.en: A guide to studying maths at Tianjin University, written for the cohorts that came after — live at zhouyixiaoxiao.info.
card.zh: 一份在天大学数学的指南，写给后来的每一届——现在在 zhouyixiaoxiao.info。

title.zh: 为 Apple Silicon 重写的 CatchMouse

card.en: A clean Swift rewrite of a 2011 Intel-only utility: global hotkeys send the cursor to the left, centre or right display.
card.zh: 把一个 2011 年、只支持 Intel 的小工具用 Swift 彻底重写：全局快捷键把光标送到左、中、右任一块屏幕。

title.zh: Pro Agent Bridge 智能体之桥

card.en: An MCP bridge that lets a chat model hand bounded coding work to local agents — extended from the open-source CodexPro.
card.zh: 一座 MCP 桥，让聊天模型把有边界的编程工作交给本地智能体——基于开源项目 CodexPro 扩展而来。

title.zh: 来路

dek.zh: 求学：天津 → 香港 → 布里斯托

card.en: Tianjin, Hong Kong, Chengdu, Geneva, Bristol: I read maths oar in hand, then took the 3+1 route (three undergraduate years, then a Bristol MSc).
card.zh: 天津、香港、成都、日内瓦、布里斯托：我一边划船一边读数学，再走「3+1」——本科三年，第四年读布里斯托硕士。

why.en: The pieces were there before the PhD: random walks already in the undergraduate thesis, and a habit of speaking up for other students that became the rep work of Chapter 06.
why.zh: 读博之前，这些线索就都在了：本科论文里已经有随机游走；替同学发声的习惯，后来成了第 6 章里的代表工作。

thesis.en: Tianjin, Hong Kong, Chengdu, Geneva, Bristol: I read maths oar in hand, then took the 3+1 route (three undergraduate years, then a Bristol MSc).
thesis.zh: 天津、香港、成都、日内瓦、布里斯托：我一边划船一边读数学，再走「3+1」——本科三年，第四年读布里斯托硕士。

title.en: BSc Mathematics & Applied Mathematics, Tianjin University
title.zh: 天津大学数学与应用数学本科

card.en: 2021–25 in the School of Mathematics, in a mathematics honours class; the final year at Bristol via the 3+1 route.
card.zh: 2021 年至 2025 年就读于数学学院荣誉数学班，最后一年经「3+1」在布里斯托完成。

title.zh: 「3+1」：第一条捷径

card.en: Three years at Tianjin, then the one-year Bristol MSc: the bachelor’s and the master’s overlapped, so the MSc began a year sooner.
card.zh: 天大三年，再读布里斯托一年制硕士：本科与硕士重叠，硕士因此早一年开始。

title.en: An exchange year at HKUST (Hong Kong University of Science and Technology)
title.zh: 在香港科技大学交换一年

card.en: 2023–24 in Hong Kong: PDEs, their numerical solution and applied statistics — where the maths turned computational.
card.zh: 2023 至 2024 年在香港：偏微分方程、数值解法与应用统计——数学从此走向计算。

title.en: MSc Engineering Mathematics (Distinction, the top UK grade for a master’s), University of Bristol
title.zh: 布里斯托大学工程数学硕士（Distinction，英国硕士最高等级）

card.en: To Bristol in Sep 2024: statistical computing, information theory, mathematical biology, methods of AI, and first-passage research.
card.zh: 2024 年 9 月来到布里斯托：统计计算、信息论、生物数学建模、人工智能方法，以及首达时间研究。

title.zh: 此刻

card.en: Now: an invited NeurIPS Fusion talk (12 Dec; second in Challenge 1), a paper submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal), one in preparation.
card.zh: 我手上正在做的：12 月 12 日的 NeurIPS 2026 聚变平衡挑战赛受邀报告（挑战一第二名）、一篇已投《物理评论 E》的论文，还有一篇正在写。

why.en: A snapshot with a date on it, so the record stays honest: finished work moves into its chapter, and each update rebuilds this page from the record.
why.zh: 这是一张带日期的快照，好让记录保持诚实：做完的事归入各章，这一页则在每次更新时由记录重新生成。

thesis.en: Now: an invited NeurIPS Fusion talk (12 Dec; second in Challenge 1), a paper submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal), one in preparation.
thesis.zh: 我手上正在做的：12 月 12 日的 NeurIPS 2026 聚变平衡挑战赛受邀报告（挑战一第二名）、一篇已投《物理评论 E》的论文，还有一篇正在写。

title.en: NeurIPS 2026 Fusion Equilibrium Challenge: second place in Challenge 1 and an invited talk
title.zh: NeurIPS 2026 聚变平衡挑战赛：挑战一第二名与受邀报告

status.zh: 受邀报告 · 2026 年 12 月 12 日

card.en: Solo entry, second in Challenge 1 (DIII-D): predicting a fusion device’s magnetic flux map without magnetic sensors; invited 15-minute talk.
card.zh: 独自参赛，获挑战一（DIII-D 装置）第二名：不用磁传感器，预测聚变装置的磁通图；受邀做 15 分钟报告。

title.zh: 几何控制的折叠：双峰论文

status.en: Submitted to Physical Review E · Jul 2026

card.en: Single-author paper submitted to Physical Review E (Jul 2026): why first-passage times can show two peaks, and when the second disappears.
card.zh: 单作者论文，2026 年 7 月投稿《物理评论 E》：随机游走首次到达目标的时间分布为何出现双峰、第二个峰何时消失。

title.zh: 从数学到 AI

line.en: The same habit — measure the hidden route — aimed first at random walkers, then at AI agents.
line.zh: 同一个习惯——测量隐藏的路径——先对准随机游走者，再对准 AI 智能体。

46 条定理，由机器核验

title.zh: UKAIRS 2026：第一作者论文录用为海报
为别人而造

line.zh: 从成都的第一次见报，到布里斯托的单口喜剧、PechaKucha（20 页幻灯片、每页 20 秒）、93 分钟大模型课和两场展会。

title.zh: 「The Lighter Side of Research」，布里斯托：七分钟单口喜剧，讲读数学博士是什么体验

title.zh: 《从短信到智能通道》：93 分钟大模型入门课

line.zh: 信任，但要验证：计算机核验的定理、3.25 亿个模拟游走粒子、保留下来的负结果、每次上线前的 AI 审查。
